AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
BirthdayBuddy manages birthday, anniversary, and name-day reminders for Android contacts. It provides functions to query upcoming events and initiate birthday messages or birthday edits.
Operational Patterns: - Always obtain a contactId by calling getUpcomingBirthdays or getContactBirthday before passing it to sendBirthdayMessage or addBirthdayToContact. - Use getUpcomingBirthdays to surface who has a birthday soon; use getContactBirthday to look up details for a named individual. - sendBirthdayMessage returns a PendingIntent — the user must tap to open the messaging app. - addBirthdayToContact returns a PendingIntent that opens the in-app edit screen for user confirmation; it does not write data directly.
Constraints: - withinDays in getUpcomingBirthdays is clamped to 1–365. - contactName matching is case-insensitive substring; the first alphabetical match is returned. - Supported values for the app parameter in sendBirthdayMessage are: whatsapp, signal, telegram, sms. - month must be 1–12 and day must be 1–31 in addBirthdayToContact.
